overview: The Medford Community Development Board received an update on the Wellington Transformation Study, approved a site plan for a mixed-use building at 360 Salem Street, approved a site plan modification for 10 and 20 Revere Beach Parkway, voted to adopt updated linkage fee rates, and reviewed draft zoning updates for Medford Square.

items.title: Wellington Transformation Study Update
items.summary: The consulting project team presented an update on the study, summarizing market data, fiscal impact analysis, design guidance buckets, and potential land use scenarios for the Wellington neighborhood.

items.title: 360 Salem Street Public Hearing
items.summary: Approved the site plan for a 14-unit mixed-use development with 16 conditions, following board votes to grant waivers reducing off-street parking requirements and approving a cash-in-lieu tree contribution for green score compliance.

items.title: 10 and 20 Revere Beach Parkway Site Plan Modification
items.summary: Approved a site plan modification to convert internal parking area to residential space, increasing the total dwelling units from 248 to 297 and reducing parking spaces from 247 to 215 within the previously approved building envelope.

items.title: Linkage Fee Rate Adjustments
items.summary: Approved an annual adjustment to the city's linkage fee schedule based on the 2.7% Consumer Price Index increase for 2025.

items.title: Medford Square District Proposed Zoning Working Session
items.summary: Reviewed revised subdistrict boundary maps and discussed dimensional standards, height definitions, and step-back provisions for the draft Medford Square zoning proposal.
